headline: Revenue grows on launches; GAAP loss from impairments
summary_short: Pfizer's Q2 2026 revenue rose 2.6% y/y to $15.03B, but a $4.3B non-cash intangible impairment drove GAAP diluted EPS to a loss of $(0.04) versus $0.51 a year ago, while Adjusted diluted EPS held at $0.77; full-year revenue guidance was raised $500M at the midpoint to $60.5-62.5B.
summary_long: Revenue grew 2.6% y/y to $15.03B (+4.0% q/q), led by 18% operational growth in launched/acquired products — Eliquis +19%, Padcev +23%, Lorbrena +37% — while Paxlovid (-95%) and Comirnaty (-34%) fell as COVID demand faded. Cost of sales rose to 27.2% of revenue (+140bp) on mix and higher acquired-inventory amortization. GAAP net loss of $248M ($(0.04) diluted LPS) reflects $4.3B of non-cash intangible impairments, partly offset by a $1.87B ViiV-stake gain; Adjusted diluted EPS held at $0.77. Cash fell to $976M from $1.70B q/q after $4.9B of H1 dividends. FY2026 revenue guidance raised $500M at the midpoint to $60.5-62.5B; Adjusted EPS guidance reaffirmed at $2.80-3.00.

drivers.explanation: 18% operational growth in launched/acquired products (Eliquis +19%, Padcev +23%, Vyndaqel family +8%, Lorbrena +37%) offset a 95% Paxlovid and 34% Comirnaty decline as COVID demand faded.
Rose to 27.2% of revenue (+140bp) on an unfavorable sales-mix shift and higher amortization of the fair-value step-up of acquired inventory, primarily tied to the Oxbryta impairment.

Driven by $4.3B of non-cash intangible impairments — $3.8B for the sigvotatug vedotin IPR&D asset after unfavorable Phase 3 results, and $525M for Oxbryta after FDA found no relaunch path — partly offset by a $1.87B gain on the ViiV stake sale.
Tracks the same intangible-impairment and legal-charge hit to Other (income)/deductions that drove operating income down; not a separately disclosed cause in the release.
Pretax swung to a $653M loss from $3.04B income on the impairment and legal charges; a tax benefit ($407M) from the jurisdictional mix of losses partly offset the hit.
Tracks the net-income swing to a loss; diluted share count was little changed (5,699M vs 5,706M a year ago) so per-share and aggregate moves track closely.
Roughly flat as 8.3% y/y cost-of-sales growth nearly offset 2.6% revenue growth — consistent with the release's own disclosed 140bp erosion in gross margin.

Management raised full-year revenue guidance $500M at the midpoint on stronger non-COVID demand, reaffirmed Adjusted EPS guidance, and announced $2.5B of additional 2027-2029 cost savings on top of existing programs.
